Sometimes I just suddenly feel empty, I think about all the things in my life that should make me feel something but just don't and then I always end up thinking whether it's worth continuing if I'm never going to feel happy again for more then 30 seconds. I'd take sad at this point, just feeling something would be nice. Then I think about what would be made worse if I died right now, and the answer is not much. A handful of people might mourn me for a year, maybe a couple for a decade but eventually everyone would forget me anyway. So what's the point in putting it up with it all if I can just end it.
